SessionStories.//ContainerEngines: 'Enabled' says the image has been built (scripts/build-tts-images.ps1 <name>); an engine whose image is missing would appear as an option and then fail. 'AcceptLicense' is a second, separate gate for models under research or non-commercial terms. Image, container name, port and models directory all default from the engine's name.
SessionStories.//Higgs: Research and non-commercial terms, with a creator-use grant that needs Boson AI credited. Accepting that is yours to decide, so it stays off until AcceptLicense is true — the image is built and the engine works.
